config.training_objective: cross-entropy over runtime candidate label token logits

selection.selection_rule: minimum development NLL including the untrained baseline
selection.precision: bfloat16 base; PEFT adapter precision as configured by library

limitations: One Qwen training seed; small local subsets.
Classical classifier support is limited to the seen banking taxonomy.
DeepSeek uses only the frozen 64-record subset; remote latency is separate.
Calibrators see only the same 96 in-domain records for all local general models.
Qwen outputs probabilities conditional on the allowed label tokens.
